fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Street View (2016-09) at the campus south entrance ~42.9028,-77.3030: a black-and-white striped barrier arm spans the truck lane, flanked by two sliding chain-link gates and STOP signs. Perimeter chain-link fencing rings the whole property. This is the single shared gate for the whole Pactiv Canandaigua campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small flat-roof booth sits immediately left of the gate (windowed on multiple sides, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, set beside the gate lane). It carries an 'Adecco' staffing-agency sign and a US flag pole — it is the staffed check-in booth at the gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a guard booth is present. A 'Pick Up Phone For Directions' call-box kiosk also sits at the gate as a secondary check-in aid, but the booth itself is the primary staffed control.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Broad paved apron and internal access road inside the gate before the trailer yards / dock banks gives ample internal queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach runs several hundred metres up the campus access road; can hold well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with two sliding-gate bays plus the barrier arm; ample paved width to add a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Plant complex (dark-roof eastern buildings): a dock apron with ~6-8 doors on the SW plant face plus additional doors along the long warehouse-adjacent faces; estimate ~40 doors campus-wide. Low-confidence overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer drop yards on the west and central campus hold well over 100 parked trailers in long rows — clearly 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces across the campus (plant SW face vs. warehouse faces) imply physically separate ship/receive flows; functional split not verifiable from imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True — large campus of 6+ connected/adjacent large buildings: the dark-roof manufacturing plant complex plus several tan-roof warehouse/distribution buildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers occupy much of the west campus, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur enters the campus from the NE, curving down the east property edge into the plant; rail cars visible parked on the spur in imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: North Street industrial corridor on the NW edge of Canandaigua (a small NY town); campus is bordered by woods, farm fields and a retention pond. Edge-of-town / rural setting.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~220 trailers counted across the visible drop-yard rows; honest estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the campus perimeter box (~145 acres); the gated property is large with substantial wooded buffer.
